title: The Silver Market in 2026: What Buyers Should Know
description: Silver demand hit 1.24 billion ounces in 2023 and industrial use now drives 58% of it. Here is what is pushing the market, where supply stands, and what it means for buyers in 2026.
alt: Silver market data cards showing 1.24 billion ounce demand record, 58% industrial share, 200 million ounce supply deficit, and solar sector consuming 140 million ounces annually
